input.name: Post Member Funds Transfer
input.description: Signs on to Meridian Core, locates a member by member number, opens Funds Transfer, fills from-share/to-share/amount/memo, reviews on the Confirm Funds Transfer screen, and posts the transaction. Returns the confirmation number and posted amount. Handles member-not-found and rejected-transaction (e.g. share on HOLD, insufficient funds) as declared business outcomes.

inputs.name: member_number
inputs.description: Member number to search for and transfer funds within

inputs.name: from_share
inputs.description: Share ID to debit (must match an option in the From Share dropdown)

inputs.name: to_share
inputs.description: Share ID to credit (must match an option in the To Share dropdown)

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Dollar amount to transfer, e.g. 1.00

inputs.name: memo
inputs.description: Memo text for the transfer

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: Confirmation number issued when the transfer posts

outputs.name: posted_amount
outputs.description: Dollar amount that was posted, as shown on the Transfer Posted screen
